profile.name: PHD2000注射泵
profile.description: PHD2000是一款实验室注射泵，用于驱动注射器进行精确的液体注入或回抽。它适合需要按设定体积输送液体的实验场景，如样品输送、流体控制和常规实验室给液。
profile.description_en: The PHD2000 is a laboratory syringe pump used to drive a syringe for precise liquid infusion or withdrawal. It is suited to experiments that require delivery of a defined liquid volume, such as sample delivery, fluid handling, and general laboratory dosing.
